post.caption:
Beavers returned to Britain after 400 years and downstream flooding dropped measurably. Wolves are back in Europe, cheetahs in India, coral is being seeded onto the Great Barrier Reef. It works when you restore a function rather than just an animal, and Oostvaardersplassen is the reminder that it can go badly.
